Mandatory KYC is triggered at the time of commencement of an account‑based relationship, i.e., when any type of account is opened with the regulated entity.

An individual can submit any one of the following Officially Valid Documents (OVDs) or the equivalent e‑document in place of the Permanent Account Number (PAN) under question 5 of the June 2025 RBI FAQ:
- Passport
- Driving licence
- Proof of possession of Aadhaar number
- Voter's Identity Card issued by the Election Commission of India
- Job card issued by NREGA duly signed by a State Government officer
- Letter issued by the National Population Register
Yes, the June 2025 RBI KYC FAQ lists a passport as an officially valid document for opening an individual account.
